# shopify_shop_policy (Resource)

The text of one shop policy, such as the terms of service or the legal notice. **A poor fit for Terraform unless the texts are maintained in the repository:** policies are legal texts that people outside the infrastructure team often edit in the admin, and Shopify generates the privacy policy. The API can't delete policies, so destroy only removes the resource from state and leaves the text in place. A type that already has text needs `adopt_existing = true`, so a text written by hand isn't overwritten silently. Shopify generates the `PRIVACY_POLICY` text while it is auto-managed; turn that off first (`shopify_privacy_settings`), and expect Shopify to reject or overwrite a write until then. Import with the policy type, such as `TERMS_OF_SERVICE`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep the text in the repository; edits made in the admin show up as drift.
resource "shopify_shop_policy" "terms" {
  type = "TERMS_OF_SERVICE"
  body = file("${path.module}/policies/agb.html")
}

# A type that already has text must be adopted, or the apply fails instead of overwriting it.
resource "shopify_shop_policy" "legal_notice" {
  type           = "LEGAL_NOTICE"
  body           = file("${path.module}/policies/impressum.html")
  adopt_existing = true
}

# Destroy only removes policies from state; the API can't delete them.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) The policy text as HTML, stored and returned as written. Can't be empty, because an empty text means no policy.
- `type` (String) Policy type. Changing it manages a different policy and leaves the old one as it is.

### Optional

- `adopt_existing` (Boolean) Take over an existing shop policy with the same natural key instead of failing. Destroy then only removes it from state. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Shop policy GID.
- `title` (String) Title Shopify gives the policy, translated into the shop's language.
- `url` (String) Public URL of the policy page.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <policy type>, only for a policy that has text
terraform import shopify_shop_policy.terms TERMS_OF_SERVICE
```
